content.text: {"core": "Transformation ends what has finished and clears the way for the next form. In Faith, it works on the thing being held through not-knowing — the commitment that waits without answers. Starved, the ending never comes: what has already died stays propped up, and the waiting hardens around a shape that stopped living, so nothing new can arrive.", "sheetLine": "The waiting keeps holding a form that already ended; nothing new can enter."}
